He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky Wildcats]]. ==High school career== Boston originally attended [[Norcross High School]] in [[Norcross, Georgia]] before transferring to [[Sierra Canyon School]] in the [[Los Angeles]] neighborhood of [[Chatsworth, Los Angeles|Chatsworth]] in 2019. He played alongside [[LeBron James|LeBron James']] son [[Bronny James]] and [[Dwyane Wade|Dwyane Wade's]] son Zaire Wade. {{cite news|url=https://www.dailynews.com/2019/07/19/sierra-canyon-basketball-adds-second-5-star-recruit-in-less-than-24-hours-bj-boston-from-georgia/ |title=Sierra Canyon basketball adds second 5-star recruit in less than 24 hours, BJ Boston from Georgia|newspaper=[[Los Angeles Daily News]]|last=Fattal|first=Tarek|date=July 19, 2019|accessdate=February 21, 2020}} In his final season at Norcross, he averaged 18.4 points and 5.4 rebounds per game.{{Cite web|url=https://www.gwinnettprepsports.com/sports/reports-norcross--star-brandon-boston-joining-star-studded-la/article_ce14fe78-b83d-5047-96a3-Reports:|title=Norcross 5-star Brandon Boston joining star-studded LA powerhouse Sierra Canyon}} He was selected to play in the [[2020 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.dailynews.com/general-news/20070910/sierra-blazes-smoke-pushed-toward-cities|title=Sierra blaze’s smoke pushed toward cities|date=September 10, 2007}} He was also selected to play in the 2020 [[Jordan Brand Classic]].{{cite news|url=https://www.kentucky.com/sports/college/kentucky-sports/uk-recruiting/article240289151.html|title=Jordan Brand Classic rosters are out.
